content: Obesity is a risk factor for the development of several cancers, such as breast, colon, and gynecologic carcinomas.1,2 Recently, it has been established that obesity not only correlates with carcinogenesis but also influences the prognosis of several cancer patients. For example, obesity has been correlated with poor prognosis in breast3,4 and colon cancers,5,6 while favorable prognoses have been reported in obese patients with gastric7 or renal8 cancers.
